wholePhysicalScope: The mapped keep and retaining wall, Suwa's measured restoration dimensions, native GSI terrain and public-domain photographs of the stone moat and current timber-and-plaster exterior.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the three copper roof tiers, park-side stairs and stone platform.
limitations: The model depicts the reconstructed keep and adjoining measured corner platform. The separate park gate, turrets and wider enclosure remain outside this scope.
Individual masonry joints, timber trim, parapets and copper ornaments are medium-fidelity approximations.
